subject: Request: tiered-reduction policy & rollback terms for NimbleCare pilot
messages:
From: Sana Patel <sana.patel@nimblecare.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot terms question — early unwind and reduction protection

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement had two items that came up during our internal review:

1) NimbleCare is comfortable with the 6-month pilot but wants an explicit tiered reduction policy in the MSA that guarantees a runway if we need to downscale before the commitment term.
2) They would like an opt-out window after month 2 with a modest fee rather than the full early termination charge — thinking of a graded rollback rather than a binary exit.

Can Redwood offer language that spells out a staged reduction (e.g., 50% allowed at month 3 with X credits, 25% at month 4, etc.) and a defined fee schedule? Legal also asked for a short mutual action plan attached to the quote.

Appreciate any options you can share; we want to keep this pilot on track.

Best,
Sana
Head of Product Ops
NimbleCare

- Finance/Legal (Laura) for final risk sign-off.

Subject: RE: Fwd: Pilot terms question — early unwind and reduction protection

Quick draft language and commercial proposal inline — marking items that require executive sign-off.

Draft clause (summary):
- Staged Reduction Schedule (Pilot: 6 months):
  * Month 1–2: no reduction permitted (onboarding window).
  * Month 3: one-time permitted capacity reduction up to 50% with a rollback fee equal to 15% of the remaining committed monthly run-rate for the remainder of the pilot.
  * Month 4: additional reduction up to 25% with rollback fee of 10% of the remaining committed monthly run-rate.
  * Month 5–6: reductions permitted but subject to pro rata billing and standard early termination (if cumulative reductions exceed 60% of original commit).
- Opt-out window: NimbleCare may fully terminate after month 2 with an opt-out fee equal to 25% of remaining committed value (discountable by Deal Desk up to 5% with VP approval).

Commercial asks that require explicit sign-off:
1) Approve maximum rollback fee discount of up to 5 percentage points (i.e., allow Deal Desk to reduce 15% -> 10% on month 3) — impacts ARR math.
2) Approve opt-out fee floor at 25% with ability to reduce to 20% only with VP (Marissa) approval.
3) Grant Karthik authority to accept NimbleCare's proposed minor redlines to MAP and execute an amended quote (no MSA amendment unless legal deems material).

Attachments: NimbleCare_Redlines_v2.pdf (attachment)

My read: risk is moderate — this preserves revenue while giving them runway. If leadership wants to protect unit economics, we can instead propose a consumption-based pilot for months 3–6, but that adds complexity. Need sign-off on (1) and (2) above so I can respond to Sana with concrete language.

-Karthik
Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear draft, Karthik. I support a staged reduction approach — it's a good middle ground to protect both parties. Two notes:

1) Discount / fee flexibility: I'm comfortable allowing Deal Desk to offer up to a 3 point reduction on the rollback fee (so 15% -> 12%) for Strategic pilots (this looks Strategic given product fit). Anything beyond that requires my direct sign-off.
2) Opt-out fee: stick to 25% as default. We can consider 20% if the customer commits to an expanded POC adoption milestone (doc'd in the MAP) — that should be toggled by the CSM/AE post-sign.

I won't sign a precedent-setting 5 point concession. If Legal flags materiality, loop in Laura for final risk tolerance. Karthik — please prepare a short executive memo summarizing revenue impact (delta to committed ARR) for my review by EOD Thursday.

-Marissa

Marissa / Karthik / Aditya,

I've reviewed the draft clause and attached redlines. Legal is comfortable with the staged reduction language as long as we:

1) Add a clear definition for "remaining committed monthly run-rate" (use net-effective post-discount).
2) Include a caps table in the MAP that enumerates credit treatment if reductions are invoked (we should avoid open-ended credits).
3) Require customer acceptance of the MAP milestone that triggers any reduced opt-out fee (i.e., 20% reduction only if they hit the agreed adoption milestone by month 2).

Commercial approvals:
- Approve Deal Desk to grant up to 3 ppt reduction on the month-3 rollback fee (15% -> 12%) without further VP sign-off.
- Maintain opt-out fee at 25% baseline; allow reduction to 20% only where MAP milestone is met and both VP (Marissa) + Legal sign off in writing.

I'm attaching the PDF redlines to forward to NimbleCare Legal and the MAP spreadsheet for signature. Karthik: please prepare the revenue-impact memo Marissa requested; include the worst-case ARR write-down and the best-case retention uplift assumptions.

Approved with conditions — please ensure everything is captured in HubSpot and the DocuSign envelope references the MAP so downstream CSMs have clear playbook.

Thanks,
